summary: Sealed bay beside the reservoir pump house, surrounded by forest, with cars parked.

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush on three sides, reservoir to the south; no buildings other than utility structures.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road reaches it, with a wide asphalt apron and several cars parked east of the building.
drivers.traffic: Quiet service road; a main road runs through the forest 60 to 80 m north.
drivers.convention: Cars (and possibly a camper) in the bay, so it is used; it is utility land though.

flags: Mapped gate 21 m west, not shown closed
Reservoir utility land, so access could be restricted
sun_shade: Tall trees shade the north and east; open sky to the south over the reservoir bank.
cannot_judge: Whether the gate is locked at night

best_section.where: Sealed bay on the east side of the small building, just north of the reservoir
